lines.text: "Milk or cider, little one? Milk. Definitely milk."
"Early bird. Porridge isn't on yet, but the kettle is."
"Busy tonight. Find a corner and shout if you want the stew."
"We're closing, friend. One cup, then home."
"Come in out of the wet! Hang your cloak by the fire."
"My best customer! Your usual corner's free."
"Half the village is drinking to your health tonight, you know."
"An inn hears everything, and repeats half of it. {rumour}"
"Quiet night. The smith lost at dice again, if that counts."
The innkeeper polishes a mug that is already clean. "{hint}"
"Tuskridge traders were in last market day. Paid in good hides, drank little, left early. Folk still stared."
"That's all I've got. Buy a drink and maybe my memory improves."
"Mutton and leek stew, barley bread, hard cheese. Same as always, and nobody's complained. Much."
"Smoked river trout, if the fishermen came back. Honey oatcakes for the little ones."
"Bring me venison and I'll pay better than the market. Trout too."
